notes: Full aerospace engineering core PLUS four of the five technical electives that must include MAE 184 (Flight Simulation Techniques) plus three from the list below; the fifth TE is a free departmentally approved technical elective.

buckets.label: Lower-division physics & chemistry
buckets.note: CHEM 6AH may be taken in place of CHEM 6A.

buckets.label: Specialization required course (Flight Dynamics and Controls)
buckets.note: MAE 184 (Flight Simulation Techniques) is required as one of the four specialization technical electives.

buckets.label: Specialization technical electives (Flight Dynamics and Controls)
buckets.note: Three courses from this list, taken together with MAE 184 to make four of the five TEs.

buckets.label: Free technical elective
buckets.note: Fifth TE; any departmentally approved upper-division/graduate technical elective.

buckets.label: Humanities & social sciences (GE/HSS)
buckets.note: Engineering-major bucket that just points to the humanities/social-sciences general-education block. At UCSD, GE/HSS coursework is defined by the student's college (Revelle, Muir, Marshall, Warren, Roosevelt, Sixth, Seventh), not by the MAE department, so there is no fixed major-level course list. The 24-unit figure reflects the approximate HSS/GE load carried outside the engineering core; the actual qualifying courses come from the college's own GE section.

buckets.label: Minimum total units for degree
buckets.note: Total/minimum unit count for the BS, not a course set. 180 units is the standard minimum required to earn a UCSD bachelor's degree; leave courses empty.
